messages:
Cheng: quick design Q — should we expose a per-SLO 'verbosity' toggle that controls how much detail is included in notify payloads + console preview? @Rachel @Alex :thinking:
Rachel: my vote is yes. we get too many giant payloads in tenant channels. toggle seems low-friction. :+1:
Alex: what would the modes be? minimal / summary / full?
Sam: also need sampling rules for noisy tenants. e.g. sample 10% of low-severity alerts, but 100% on ramp/burn signals.
Cheng: thinking two axes — `verbosity` (summary | with-metrics | full-events) and `sampling` (rate-based + burst cap). console preview should respect `verbosity` and show a "show more" that fetches full payload.
Rachel: telemetry concern — enabling `full-events` could spike storage/egress for some orgs. need quotas and an estimated-cost preview in console.
Maria K.: API proposal: add `notify.level` and `notify.sample_rate` to SLO config. default should be `summary` and sample_rate=1 for critical slos. keep backwards compat.
Alex: sample config snippet:
```
{
  "slo_id": "svc/p99_latency",
  "notify": {"level":"summary","sample_rate":0.1}
}
```
Sam: runtime note: routing layer must stamp `sampled=true|false` and suppress large `events` keys when not `full-events`. that keeps downstream consumers simpler.
Deploy Bot: canary deploy queued to staging at 14:03 :shipit:
Cheng: rollout UX idea — behind a feature-flag; default off for orgs that cross an egress threshold; admins can preview estimated egress/cost delta before enabling.
Rachel: tests: add e2e asserting no notify payload >100KB when `summary` mode set, and add telemetry counter `notify.payload_size_bytes` tagged by tenant/level.
Alex: also add escalation override: if severity >= high then always send full regardless of sample. important for oncall.
Sam: +1 and preserve correlation IDs/traces even in `summary` so debugging still links.
Maria K.: I'll draft the API PR with field names and migration notes. tagging @eng-sre for noise budget implications.
Cheng: next steps: Maria PR, Alex+Sam to sketch runtime changes + gating, Rachel to update telemetry dashboards and cost estimate UI. ping back in the design sync next Tue. Thanks everyone! :tada:
